projectTitle: Multi-Agent Results Gallery (Breaking Bad + Mad Men)

scenes.title: Breaking Bad S1E1 — Scene 001: Desert Landscape
scenes.prompt: Slow pan across the desert landscape with subtle heat shimmer and light wind moving sparse shrubs. Keep realism, no people.

scenes.title: Breaking Bad S1E1 — Scene 002: RV Speeds Past
scenes.prompt: RV speeds past, kicking up dust; briefly runs over/brushes past the pants. Slight handheld shake, realistic suspension bounce, maintain the same RV design.

scenes.title: Breaking Bad S1E1 — Scene 003: Driver Panics
scenes.prompt: Inside the RV, the driver panics while driving; heavy breathing behind the mask, hands tight on the wheel, vehicle vibration. Keep the same face and outfit throughout, no face morphing.

scenes.title: Breaking Bad S1E1 — Scene 004: Chaotic RV
scenes.prompt: The RV swerves; objects and cash slide, liquid sloshes. Avoid explicit drugs/graphic bodies; show only generic clutter. Emphasize motion and chaos.

scenes.title: Breaking Bad S1E1 — Scene 005: RV Rough Stop
scenes.prompt: RV loses control slightly and comes to a rough stop near a ditch. Big dust plume, then settling silence. Camera handheld but readable.

scenes.title: Breaking Bad S1E1 — Scene 006: Exit the RV
scenes.prompt: Using the reference image as the first frame, generate an 8-second shot: the man steps out, stumbles one step, yanks off the gas mask, and gasps. Dust floats and settles. Keep framing and lighting consistent with the first frame; maintain identity and outfit.

scenes.title: Mad Men S1E1 — Clip 001: Bar Establishing (approach from behind)
scenes.prompt: Use the bar reference as the exact first frame. 8s slow push-in inside a smoky 1960s cocktail lounge toward a suited man seated at the bar from behind; ambient crowd motion and haze; handheld micro-shake only; no text.
scenes.notes: New demo: lower cut density, character-focused.

scenes.title: Mad Men S1E1 — Clip 002: Continuous Take (Part A) — OTS writing → lighter
scenes.prompt: Use the reference image as the exact first frame (same framing, same identity, same bar surface, same paper, pen, lighter, one cigarette). 8s continuous take, no cuts: slow straight dolly-in only. Hand keeps writing on the same paper, then reaches for the same lighter to prepare lighting the same cigarette. No new props, no extra cigarettes.
scenes.notes: Continuity test setup for multi-clip one-take.

scenes.title: Mad Men S1E1 — Clip 003: Continuous Take (Part B) — tilt up to profile
scenes.prompt: Using the provided first frame (taken from the end of the previous clip), continue the SAME continuous shot for 8 seconds: finish the push-in and subtly tilt up to reveal the man’s face in profile as he exhales smoke and keeps thinking. No cuts, no identity drift, consistent lighting and props.

scenes.title: Mad Men S1E1 — Clip 004: Waiter enters (subtle interaction)
scenes.prompt: Medium two-shot at the bar: the seated man and a generic waiter leaning in. 8s minimal motion: the waiter speaks briefly, the man glances up and responds subtly. Keep main character identity stable, warm smoky tungsten lighting, no text, no extra props.

scenes.title: Mad Men S1E1 — Clip 005: Close-up (micro-expressions + smoke)
scenes.prompt: Close-up of the man’s face, cigarette smoke drifting, warm tungsten key light, shallow depth of field. 8s micro-expression only: eyes shift slightly, slow exhale smoke. Avoid face warping and random zoom; maintain identity.

scenes.title: Mad Men S1E1 — Clip 006: Return to medium (put down pen → rise to leave)
scenes.prompt: Medium shot at the bar: the man puts down the pen, takes a final drag, and starts to rise from the stool. 8s calm motion, warm smoky lighting, handheld realism. Keep identity/wardrobe/bar continuity; no new props; no random camera zoom.
